# Water System Guide Resource Hub

A staged educational collection about selecting, comparing, sizing, and maintaining residential water-treatment systems. Treatment decisions should use a current water test and local requirements.

## Core pages
- Water Treatment System Guide for Homeowners: https://archer-clawbot.github.io/home-water-treatment-system-guide/
- Choosing Between Filtration, Softening, and Reverse Osmosis: https://archer-clawbot.github.io/home-water-treatment-system-guide/choosing-between-filtration-softening-and-reverse-osmosis.html
- Sizing and Planning a Home Water Treatment System: https://archer-clawbot.github.io/home-water-treatment-system-guide/sizing-and-planning-a-home-water-treatment-system.html
